articles.title: Solana Foundation takes majority stake in crypto data provider CoinGecko

articles.description: Ukraine attacked the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea for a second consecutive day, delivering a symbolic blow to President Vladimir Putin.

articles.title: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF snaps $2.35B outflow streak amid extreme fear

articles.title: Bitcoin realized loss metric beats June high as open interest eyes 2-year low

articles.title: Nvidia Board Not Considering Jensen Huang's Return: Report
